en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Anbasa Al Aabid who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If you cannot be with the weeping, so pretend (try) to weep’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from ‘Anbasah al-‘Abid who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘If you cannot weep then make a weeping-like face.’”
